note: The Network pass after the sixth sample (4 November 2026): one-stage ties screened under the owner's implied-ties rule, and episode texts in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., The Spectacular Spider-Man, Luke Cage, Loki, X-Men '97 and Agent Carter corrected to their own episode, each fix confirmed by a second checker; plus the owner's two removals (records in mockup-data/audit2/net/pass7).

edit.text: Dottie knocks Peggy out with a drugged kiss, and as she falls Peggy sees the handcuff scars that mark Dottie as the Leviathan operative.
edit.whoA: Dottie's hotel friend and secret target, knocked out by her drugged kiss.
edit.whoB: A hotel friend who secretly spies on Peggy for Leviathan, then knocks her out.

edit.text: Vernon Masters walks into the SSR office with FBI agents and halts Peggy Carter's planned raid on the Arena Club with an executive order and an audit. When she refuses to name her informant, he warns her that her allies may not survive the changes coming.
Sousa and Peggy Carter meet Whitney Frost to trade fake uranium rods for Jason Wilkes. When a dropped case exposes the fakes, Frost orders her men to kill them and gives chase.
edit.whoA: The woman Sousa investigates, then tricks with fake uranium.
edit.whoB: The SSR chief in Los Angeles, who tricks Whitney with fake uranium.
edit.title: Agent Carter S2

edit.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and threaten him into carrying an offer to Whitney Frost, his former lover: the uranium rods for Jason Wilkes.
edit.whoB: An SSR agent who threatens Manfredi into carrying a message to Whitney.

edit.text: When Jack catches Masters taking orders from Whitney Frost and confronts him, Masters wipes his memory with the memory inhibitor.
edit.whoA: Jack's old mentor, who wipes his memory.

edit.text: Jack Thompson goes to Whitney Frost to tell her the Gamma Cannon is not ready, and her partner Joseph Manfredi calls him stupid and threatens him. Thompson is secretly playing Frost and Vernon Masters against each other, planning to blow them both up.
edit.whoB: An agent Manfredi threatens, who secretly plans to blow up Frost.

edit.text: Manfredi drags Wilkes out of the car and orders him to obey, then guards him while Frost tries to pull the Zero Matter out of him, at one point warning her that she will kill him.

Worried about Frost's obsession with the rift, Manfredi holds Jarvis at gunpoint to reach Stark, Peggy and Wilkes over a late breakfast, and agrees to help them by distracting Frost while they steal her plans.
Antoine Triplett comes aboard the Bus with John Garrett and stays behind with Jemma Simmons, helping her treat the dying Skye and showing an attraction to her.
Felix Blake and Victoria Hand join Coulson aboard the Bus to plan the hunt for the Clairvoyant. After Deathlok nearly kills Blake, Hand tells Coulson his plan was flawed from the start.
edit.whoA: Agent Blake hunts the Clairvoyant with. Blames Coulson's plan when Blake is hurt.
edit.whoB: Agent Hand hunts the Clairvoyant with, until Deathlok nearly kills him.

edit.text: Trip joins Coulson's team, and he and Skye flee the Hub together and follow Coulson's coordinates to Providence.
Trip follows Skye into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to save her, kicking the Diviner off its pedestal as the mist transforms her.
edit.whoA: Trip's friend, whom he dies trying to save in the Kree temple.
edit.whoB: Daisy's friend, who dies trying to save her in the Kree temple.

edit.text: Antoine Triplett joins Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls and leaves the Hub with May and the others to follow Coulson's coordinates to Providence.
After Ward's betrayal, Melinda May talks with Skye about him and offers to be her new supervising officer, taking over her training.
edit.whoA: Daisy's trainer and supervising officer.
edit.whoB: May's trainee.

edit.text: Garrett orders Grant Ward to kill Jemma and Fitz, and Ward ejects them into the ocean instead of shooting them.
edit.whoA: Hydra's Clairvoyant, who wins the team's trust, then orders Jemma killed.
edit.whoB: An agent of Coulson's whom Garrett orders Ward to kill.

edit.text: Fury pulls Jemma and the unconscious Fitz out of the ocean. On his jet he tells her Fitz is alive, and she tells him where to find Coulson.

Carl Creel kills Roger Browning during a deal with Isabelle Hartley's team, then attacks her again when she finds the Obelisk, and it infects her arm when she grabs it to defend herself. She survives losing the arm, but Creel then causes the car crash that kills her.
After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Melinda May tracks down Maria Hill outside a Senate hearing to find out who ran Project T.A.H.I.T.I., the program that brought Coulson back.
edit.whoA: An agent who tracks Hill down to ask about T.A.H.I.T.I.
edit.whoB: Fury's deputy, whom May tracks down to ask about T.A.H.I.T.I.

edit.text: Coulson keeps Fitz on his team despite the brain damage that leaves him withdrawn, and has him working on cloaking for the Bus.
edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2

edit.text: At Afterlife, Raina tells a doubtful Skye that Jiaying is misleading the Inhumans. Raina then provokes Jiaying into killing her where Skye can see, so that Skye learns the truth.
edit.whoA: A fellow Inhuman, whose death at Jiaying's hands shows Daisy the truth.

add.text: Skye storms the Centipede facility and knocks Raina out with a punch to rescue Coulson, and Raina is arrested.
add.whoA: A Centipede operative Daisy knocks out to rescue Coulson.
add.whoB: A hacker who knocks Raina out to rescue Coulson.
add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1

edit.text: Mack helps Fitz rebuild the Overkill Device into the weapon that lets Coulson take down Carl Creel.
edit.whoA: The man Coulson takes down with a weapon Mack helps build.

edit.text: Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, offers him money to betray Coulson. Hunter names his price: two million dollars and a proper burial for Isabelle Hartley.
Fitz helps Coulson's team understand Donnie when he resurfaces with freezing powers. He learns from Ward that HYDRA has brainwashed Donnie and warns the team.

Sunil Bakshi grills Jemma for hiding that she knew Donnie Gill, then takes her on the mission to bring Donnie in and feeds her lines to say. She keeps her cover by pretending to save him from Skye's shot.
edit.whoA: Jemma's HYDRA superior while she spies. Questions her loyalty, but she fools him.

edit.text: Lance Hunter bets Mack that Skye went to the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, loses, and has to do inventory work for him.
edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2

edit.text: Mack locks Hunter in a S.H.I.E.L.D. safe house, brings him pizza and a beer, and reminisces about the Dubai mission where they and Bobbi first met. He then hands Hunter, blindfolded, over to the "real S.H.I.E.L.D."
Mack tells Jemma Simmons that he only knows the new Fitz and thinks Fitz is better off without her around, and she tearfully agrees.

edit.whoA: A woman Ward comes for and takes to Hydra.

edit.text: Lance Hunter helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver, and when she tries to surrender to Hydra, he and May drive her clear.
Trip follows Skye and Raina into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to stop the Diviner from transforming them.

Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior who comes to Earth to destroy the Diviners and those they change, sees Skye as a weapon that must be destroyed. He hunts her through the Playground until Fitz blasts him and Bobbi wipes his memory with his own truncheon.
Gordon teleports Cal out of his standoff with Coulson at Manitowoc, saying he draws too much attention. He tells Cal he is not one of them, just a science experiment.

During the Hydra Uprising, Bobbi helps rescue the wounded Gonzales on the Iliad and fights beside him to retake the ship instead of sinking it. Now his loyal agent, she steals Coulson's toolbox and opens his base to Gonzales' raid.
After Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. seizes the Playground, Hunter meets the escaped Coulson and signs a napkin as his contract, becoming a permanent agent to help retake the base.
When Fitz opens Fury's Toolbox to reach Coulson while Robert Gonzales' agents tail him, Lance Hunter talks him through how to shake the tail.
edit.whoA: A good friend Hunter talks through shaking Gonzales' agents.
edit.whoB: A good friend who helps Fitz shake Gonzales' agents.

edit.text: Andrew Garner, May's ex-husband, has been meeting with Phil Coulson in secret, and May uncovers it while looking into Coulson's hidden plans.
edit.whoA: A friend Andrew secretly meets with.
edit.whoB: May's ex-husband, who secretly meets with Coulson.

edit.text: After Mike is rescued from HYDRA, Fitz tells him HYDRA dismantled his leg and promises to send him to a facility where he can be rebuilt.
edit.whoA: A friend Fitz promises to have rebuilt after HYDRA's experiments.
edit.whoB: A friend who promises to get Mike rebuilt.

edit.text: At Afterlife, Lincoln Campbell trusts Gordon, the teleporter who is the community's only link to the outside world.
May backs Coulson's plan and joins the raid on Dr. List's Hydra base that frees Mike from his cell.
Bobbi Morse shows Kara Palamas kindness at S.H.I.E.L.D., but Kara remembers what Bobbi did to her and, disguised as May, ambushes Bobbi on a quinjet so Grant Ward can take her.
edit.whoA: An agent Bobbi shows kindness to, who turns on her for Ward.
edit.whoB: The agent Kara ambushes and helps Ward kidnap.

edit.text: Skye is upset that Gonzales, not Coulson, comes to Afterlife to meet her mother Jiaying, who kills him.
edit.whoA: Leader of the rival S.H.I.E.L.D., killed by Daisy's mother at Afterlife.

edit.text: Gideon Malick has Andrew Garner's containment module moved out of Endotex Labs and visits him there, offering to help him in exchange for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets.

Coulson lures Giyera into an empty room where May is waiting, and she beats him hand to hand. Held prisoner aboard Zephyr One, he breaks free, hijacks the plane and forces it down at a Hydra base, leaving May badly wounded.
After Lincoln is locked up as Hive's suspected spy, Yo-Yo gives Jemma blood samples to test for Hive's infection, then demands to be let go from S.H.I.E.L.D.
edit.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who tests Yo-Yo's blood for Hive's infection.
edit.whoB: Secret Warrior who gives Jemma blood samples, then walks out on S.H.I.E.L.D.

edit.text: At Momentum Labs, Robbie, as Ghost Rider, saves Mack and Fitz from the ghost Frederick and destroys him.
When the Spirit of Vengeance passes to Mack, Robbie finds him at the Chinatown Crew hideout and strikes a new deal with the Spirit, freeing Mack and taking it back.
edit.whoA: Saves Mack from a ghost, then frees him from the Spirit of Vengeance.

edit.text: Enoch, a Chronicom observer, sends Mack and the team into the future.
Wearing the new arms Fitz built her, Yo-Yo helps Simmons trick Mack into letting Fitz out of his cell, then locks Mack in it and leaves with the pair to hunt Hydra's weapon.
edit.whoA: Friend who builds Yo-Yo new arms. She helps break him out of his cell.
edit.whoB: Friend Fitz builds new arms for, who helps break him out of his cell.

edit.text: When Deke stays behind to back up Daisy against Ruby, Hale arrives with her Mechs and shoots him in the shoulder, nearly killing him.
edit.whoB: A suspect Hale tracks as an LMD, then shoots in the shoulder.

edit.text: When Daisy and May raid the Hydra Academy, Hale surrenders at once and asks for help stopping Ruby. At the facility she and Daisy try to calm Ruby, who has lost control of the Gravitonium.
When May and Daisy board Qovas' ship to bring Coulson back, Talbot, now powered by gravitonium, knocks Daisy out and forces May to surrender.
edit.whoA: Agent Talbot forces to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.
edit.whoB: Gravitonium-powered general who forces May to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.
edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5

edit.text: Tucker Shockley grows impatient as Aida maps Billy Koenig's brain for the Darkhold. When the Superior orders her and Radcliffe removed, Aida kills a Watchdog and crushes Shockley's hand.
edit.whoA: One of the Superior's men. Aida crushes his hand.
edit.whoB: An android who crushes Shockley's hand on the Watchdogs' sub.

edit.text: Aida turns on Radcliffe and slits his wrists, so his body dies while his mind stays trapped in the Framework.
In the Framework, Fitz, now Hydra's ruthless Doctor, ignores Radcliffe's pleas to remember who he really is. He kills Agnes and takes Radcliffe prisoner.
edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4

edit.text: Davis helps pull Fitz out of the chamber where Aida, now the human Ophelia, attacks him. He keeps shooting her so Piper can get Fitz away, but her wounds heal and she leaves him for dead.
Ruby Hale, General Hale's daughter, ambushes May and the team with androids at an aerospace facility.
edit.whoA: General Hale's daughter. Ambushes May's team.

edit.text: Daniel Whitehall teaches R. Hale at Hydra's academy and chooses her to bear the child he designs to be Hydra's future leader. She agrees and raises her daughter Ruby for that purpose.

Enoch warns Atarah that her mind machine is too dangerous for Jemma and Fitz. Told to choose between his people and his friends, he chooses his friends, knocks out the Chronicoms and helps the two escape.

Enoch warns Atarah that her mind machine is too dangerous for Fitz and Jemma. Told to choose between his people and his friends, he chooses his friends, knocks out the Chronicoms and helps the two escape.
Sibyl hears from her Hunters that their plan to kill Freddy in 1931 failed because S.H.I.E.L.D. saved him.

Daisy learns that Kora, who has sided with Nathaniel Malick, is her half-sister, a daughter of Jiaying who died before Daisy was born in the original history. Captured by Coulson, Kora says she wanted to meet her sister.
edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7

edit.whoB: Sousa's love, who first meets him at Area 51 in 1955.

add.text: Posing as a CIA agent at Area 51, Daisy wins Sousa over and gets him to take her to her captured teammates, who then lock him in their cell.
add.whoA: An SSR agent Daisy wins over at Area 51.
add.whoB: An agent who poses as CIA to win him over at Area 51.
add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7

edit.text: Turk Barrett meets Tone, Cottonmouth's bodyguard, and tells him that Chico Diaz is hiding in Pop's barbershop.
edit.whoA: The snitch who tells Tone where Chico is hiding.

add.text: Luke washes dishes at Cottonmouth's club, Harlem's Paradise. Filling in at the bar, he brings Cottonmouth drinks and turns down his job offer.
add.whoA: A dishwasher at Harlem's Paradise who turns down his job offer.
add.whoB: The owner of Harlem's Paradise, where Luke washes dishes.
add.title: Luke Cage S1

edit.text: Kora confronts Nathaniel about killing her mother, Jiaying, but he wins her back with lies about Jiaying. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.
Nathaniel argues with Sibyl to let him kill the agents, but she orders him not to interfere so Daisy can reach Simmons. He sends Kora after Daisy anyway.
After years apart from the team, Fitz comes through a portal and reunites with May and the others in 1983.

Ouroboros, the TVA's repair technician, once shared a friendly bond with Mobius, who nicknamed him O.B., but Mobius forgets him over the centuries. When they meet again, O.B. happily reminisces while Mobius pretends to remember, and O.B. sends Mobius out to the Temporal Loom to pull Loki out of time.
edit.whoA: An old friend Mobius nicknamed O.B., then forgot. Helps him pull Loki out of time.
edit.whoB: An old friend who forgot Ouroboros and pretends otherwise. Goes out to the Loom to pull Loki free.

edit.text: Mobius tracks Hunter X-5 down on the red carpet in 1977, where the deserter lives as the actor Brad Wolfe, and pesters him about a sequel before Loki blocks his escape. In holding, X-5 taunts Mobius for never looking into his own life before the TVA until Mobius slaps him.

In the Void, Mobius pulls Sylvie away from Alioth, apologizes for what the TVA did to her as a child and backs her plan to enchant the creature. She gives him her TemPad so he can go back and expose the TVA.

add.text: Mobius hunts the Variant who has been attacking the TVA, and when she and Loki set off a Nexus Event on Lamentis-1, he sends Timedoors to bring them in.
add.whoA: The Variant Mobius hunts and has brought in from Lamentis-1.
add.whoB: The TVA agent who hunts Sylvie and has her captured.
add.title: Loki S1

edit.text: Luke tracks down Turk Barrett, whose tip-off led to Pop's death, throws him into a dumpster and crushes it shut until Turk gives up Diamondback's warehouse.
Shades kills Candace Miller, the witness against Mariah, so she walks free. When Harlem's Paradise reopens, the two share a kiss.
Luke pulls Tilda and her mother Mariah Dillard out of the burning house where Bushmaster leaves them.
Tilda urges Bushmaster to kill her mother, shows him the secret passages into Harlem's Paradise and gives him a supershot of nightshade.
Misty takes Shades's confession in return for immunity and sends him back to Mariah for the gun, which he hands over as the evidence against her.
Disappointed that Luke is stepping in as Harlem's crime boss, D.W. tells him Pop's is neutral ground where he can get a haircut but not talk business.
edit.whoA: D.W.'s hero, whom he scolds for acting as Harlem's crime boss.
edit.whoB: A young fan who scolds Luke for acting as Harlem's crime boss.

edit.text: Tilda visits Mariah in jail and turns down her offer to start over. Her goodbye kiss carries a poison that soon kills Mariah.

Betty Brant is the Bugle secretary who gets Peter back into the office to collect his pay. Peter has a crush on her and tries to ask her to the Fall Formal, but a tremor from the Shocker cuts him off.
The Goblin kidnaps Hammerhead and tries to recruit him. When Hammerhead stays loyal to Tombstone, the Goblin uses him as bait, dangling him over molten metal.
Desperate to impress Norman, Harry secretly takes Oscorp's Globulin Green formula. Found in the Goblin's costume, he collapses, and Norman takes him away to recover.
Otto brings Marko into his Sinister Six. Electro frees Sandman from Ryker's Island as part of Otto's breakout, and Sandman fights Spider-Man under Otto's lead.
Otto brings O'Hirn into his Sinister Six. Electro frees Rhino from Ryker's Island as part of Otto's breakout, and Rhino fights Spider-Man under Otto's lead.
Montana joins the Sinister Six, which Doctor Octopus forms to destroy Spider-Man.
Quentin Beck and Phineas Mason both work on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man, and both end up arrested.
Otto is unmasked as the Master Planner, the hidden boss Mysterio stole tech for and fought under in the new Sinister Six.
edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man

edit.text: Otto is unmasked as the Master Planner, the boss who brought Kraven into the new Sinister Six and sent him to break Electro out of Ravencroft.
As the Master Planner's right hand, the Vulture snatches Gwen off the street and flies away with her before Peter can follow.
Spider-Man rescues Gwen from the Master Planner's lair. At midnight, while Gwen is on the phone with Peter, Liz kisses him.
Peter sees Harry come back to school from Europe, knowing his friend was once the Green Goblin.
Tombstone hires the Tinkerer to build new suits for the Enforcers, and Spider-Man has to face them in the new gear.
At the Valentine's Day summit, Doctor Octopus turns on Spider-Man in the gang war, but Spider-Man ties up his arms and he is arrested.
At the Valentine's Day summit, Hammerhead betrays the crime bosses and starts a gang war that Spider-Man has to stop.
Jean confronts Madelyne telepathically and uses their shared memories to free her from Sinister's control.
Nathan returns from the future grown as the soldier Cable and saves the X-Men from Trask. Through Jean, Scott learns Cable is his son, but Cable has no interest in a reunion.
At Bastion's hideout, Sinister seizes control of the grown Cable's mind and forces him to fight Jean.
Veb is one of the Freedom Fighters resisting Kang's rule. Kang's Quantumnauts capture and imprison him, and he fights in the uprising against Kang at Chronopolis.
edit.whoA: A Freedom Fighter who rises up against Kang.
edit.whoB: The conqueror whose Quantumnauts imprison Veb and the rebels.

edit.text: Ward hunts Petra Larsen and Jakob Nystrom's Paganists for the Berserker Staff. At the church in Ireland, after he beats Nystrom and their followers, Petra tries to take the staff from him, and May stops her.
The zombie Thor joins Wanda's horde in Paris and kills Sara and the London Master, Rintrah's fellow sorcerers, as they defend Banner. Rintrah falls to the horde in the same battle.
edit.whoB: A Kamar-Taj sorcerer whose companions he kills.
